fusions.name: Downburst
fusions.desc: Brings a downdraught crashing onto every enemy within 4 tiles, dealing 32 damage that ignores armour. Every hit leaves the target [Sundered] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Level Blow
fusions.desc: Flattens the target with a pressing blow of air that deals 14 damage, using up every affliction on it to add 1.2 times their remaining damage, and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Air Beaten Flat
fusions.desc: Beats the air flat into a wall 6 tiles long ahead of you for 6 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Anvil Rhythm
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: a gust slams it for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (170% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
